scope: R149 complete device-event step budget (no sync in forward)
fa_wrapper_note: the FA wrapper was installed once per hook-group call, so each launch was recorded 3 times; the FA total below divides the recorded sum by that factor

ten_second_arithmetic.verdict: even eliminating the whole FA term leaves 9.88 s, so 10 s cannot be reached by optimising FA alone

optimistic_projection.note: 2x FA and linears at their measured standalone rates still lands around 12-13 s

conclusion: 10 s/step is not reachable under the current contract. FA alone is 45% of the step and eliminating it entirely would only reach 9.88 s; the realistic floor with 2x FA and GEMM at standalone rates is about 12-13 s.
options_for_user: accept a revised target around 12-13 s with the contract intact
authorise a change to the mathematical contract (sparse or approximate attention, fewer steps, lower precision) - currently explicitly forbidden
authorise a hardware/parallelism change outside TP2+USP4
